attack.note: Almost all damage is basic attacks in Phase Bomb (splash, more range) or Repeater Cannon (150 percent attack speed). Plasma Cutter is a slow and set up tool, and the Heroic Purification Salvo is the only burst.

poke.note: Phase Bomb splash attacks from range, plus Plasma Cutter circling for a slow. Hard to dodge because it is a basic attack and Shield Capacitor lets him keep trading chip.

damage.note: Damage is a steady stream of splash basic attacks that an AoE sustained healer partly offsets, and the Shield Capacitor lets him return to trades after regenerating shields. He does not have big burst except Purification Salvo. Measured hero damage per minute is above median at about 2760 and siege is about 5370, damage taken about 1860 (close to median).

good_into.why: Shield Capacitor regenerates 10 percent per second after 5 seconds without damage (Rapid Recharge cuts that to 3), so chip damage is wasted against him, and Phase Bomb out ranges many short range pokers.
Plasma Cutter slows melee heroes and Target Acquired gives him speed, so he kites them while splashing the group.
Phase Bomb splash and Plasma Cutter clear minions, mercenaries and summons very fast from range.
Offensive Cadence deals 6 percent max health on every third Repeater Cannon attack, and Photonic Weaponry adds 20 percent damage while shielded.
Splash with a slow and Purification Salvo (50 percent more to slowed targets) punishes grouped backline heroes if he is not interrupted.

bad_into.why: He has no hard crowd control and Warp is a channel that stuns and knockbacks cancel. The guide names E.T.C. and Lucio.
Assassins such as Zeratul and Genji follow Warp and are hard to peel, and large hitbox makes him easy to hit.
Divers burst through the shield. Divert Power drains the shield afterward and Warp is the only escape.
Other long range heroes out poke him when his shield is down, and his shield has to recharge out of combat so he loses the trade over a long skirmish.

wants_from_team: Heroes that pull or clump enemies together such as Johanna or Diablo
Slows on the whole enemy team for Purification Salvo
A frontline that stops dives while he trades from range
Burst healing like Uther if he takes Rapid Recharge
gives_team: Strong solo lane and fast wave and camp clear
Sustained area damage and siege from range
Plasma Cutter slow that helps teammates land skillshots
Safe poking trades thanks to Shield Capacitor
weaknesses: Large hitbox, easy to hit with skillshots
Must retreat to recharge shields, healers cannot refill the base shield
Warp is a channel that can be interrupted
evidence: Shield Capacitor, Plasma Cutter, Weapon Modes, Warp
Offensive Cadence, Photonic Weaponry, Target Acquired, Rapid Recharge
Icy Veins counters section (Varian, Zeratul, Genji, E.T.C., Lucio)
Measured block: hero damage about 2760, siege about 5370 per minute, win rate 0.532 over 250 games
owner_notes: A medium range sustain damage hero. Can solo like Raynor but is often in a 3 or 4 man, where he catches waves and ganks like Sylvanas, Raynor or Greymane.

lens_notes.damage_delivery: Phase Bomb splash autos are the damage and Plasma Cutter adds slow and chip.
lens_notes.kill_pattern: Owner read: trades with shields and ganks like Sylvanas, Raynor or Greymane in a group of 3 or 4. Purification Salvo is the only burst.
lens_notes.lane_role: Owner read: can solo like Raynor but often plays in a group of 3 or 4, catching waves.
lens_notes.durability_source: Permanent shield that regenerates out of combat. Healers cannot refill the base shield, except with Rapid Recharge.
lens_notes.escape: Warp is a 0.5 second channel, and a stun during it cancels it.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Warp can be interrupted, so there is no real answer.
lens_notes.setup_reliance: Plasma Cutter slows set up his own Salvo.
lens_notes.power_curve: Dominant in lane early, Purification Salvo at 10 and the level 16 talents give the spike.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Purification Salvo secures kills. Planet Cracker needs setup and is easy to sidestep.
lens_notes.objective_role: Phase Bomb splash sieges well (5370 per minute against 4430).

lens_gaps: no lens for durability that is a regenerating shield only out of combat (a trade hero), armor_or_shield hides the kiting weakness
no value on utility_tool for dodging damage by phasing out (Warp)
